title: Kathanayagan
desc: A revenue inspector falls in love with a girl but faces problems due to his cowardliness. He is compelled to find a way to prove himself to her father, who wants her to marry a brave man.

title: Ivan Veramathiri
desc: Guna kidnaps Eeswaran, brother of a minister, for orchestrating violence among students. However, Eeswaran escapes and trails after Guna to exact his revenge.

title: Raja Rani
desc: Two people enter an arranged marriage to please their parents, living as strangers under one roof. However, an unforeseen event prompts them to reassess their relationship and emotions.

title: Naa Saami Ranga
desc: A man gains great notoriety in his village for his unmatched strength and brutal nature, which makes him a target of antisocial elements with a ruthless agenda.

title: Naan Aanaiyittal
desc: Pandiyan, a gang member seeking reform, is framed for murder, forcing him to disguise himself as a wealthy man's missing son to evade danger.

title: Finder -- Project 1
desc: A pair of criminology graduates start a firm to prove the innocence of people wrongly framed and punished for criminal offences.

title: Saivam
desc: When ill luck befalls a family, Kathiresan decides to please the gods by offering their pet rooster as a sacrifice. However, things do not go as expected as the rooster goes missing.

title: Raid
desc: In what may be the longest raid of his career, a righteous income tax officer takes on a corrupt politician who will go to any lengths to evade legal consequences.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Thillu Mullu
desc: Chandran lies to his boss in order to go and watch a football match, but his boss also attends the match and catches him. Later, to save his job, Chandran is forced to lie about having a twin brother.

title: Lucky Man
desc: An unlucky real estate agent experiences a bit of luck when he wins a car in a contest. However, things take a turn after the car is stolen by anonymous assailants.

title: Ramleela-Govindudu Andariva
desc: Upset that his son wants to settle in London, Balaraju has a bitter argument with him. Later, his grandson travels to India to mend the relationship between his father and grandfather.

title: Kuselan
desc: Two childhood friends lose touch over the years as one grows up to become a national figure while another makes a living out of barbering. Little do they know that a surprise reunion is on the cards.

title: Sigaram Thodu
desc: The son of a brave yet impaired policeman, Murali, dreams of a secure future in banking. However, unforeseen circumstances lead him to follow his father's footsteps in law enforcement.

title: Bruce Lee 2 the Fighter
desc: Kartik sacrifices his studies for his sister and becomes a stuntman. But he ends up helping a cop to unearth the evil designs of Deepak.

title: Vinaya Vidheya Rama
desc: Facing a menacing criminal kingpin, Ram fights to protect his family. Soon, he embarks on a daring mission to topple the villain and dismantle his corrupt empire.
